title: VisualErase: Dual-Branch Visual Trajectory Redirection for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: VisualErase：面向文本到图像扩散模型中稳健概念擦除的双分支视觉轨迹重定向

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase , a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone. The project page is https://qianlong0502.github.io/VisualErase-Homepage/ .
paragraphs.zh: 概念擦除对于文本到图像扩散模型的安全部署至关重要，因为这些模型可能会重现从无约束的大规模数据中学到的有害、受版权保护或涉及隐私的内容。 现有方法通常通过重定向与目标相关的文本到图像映射，在保留一般生成能力的同时擦除不需要的概念。 然而，近期研究表明，经过擦除的模型可能仍然保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，这使其容易受到对抗性恢复攻击，也揭示了重定向文本到图像映射与真正移除视觉知识之间存在根本性差距。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 VisualErase——一种新的范式，它将承载概念的视频生成轨迹重定向至明确定义的去除了该概念的输出结果。 为了实现这种重定向，我们使用结构保留的图像编辑技术，为源图像构建内容对齐且去除了目标概念的对应图像，从而提供明确的视觉终点，同时保留非目标内容。 接着，我们从每一对源图像与对应图像的配对中推导出降噪目标，并使用双分支重定向损失函数，使文本条件和无条件预测都与该目标对齐，因为仅靠条件监督无法明确约束无文本引导的生成过程。 为了减轻概念擦除对非目标生成产生的负面影响，我们将重定向损失与对应图像保留损失进行联合优化，后者用于匹配冻结预训练模型生成的降噪预测结果。 在风格、名人身份和裸体内容的擦除任务中，VisualErase 在七种攻击下的最大攻击成功率分别被限制为 0%、8% 和 0.1%，同时保持了整体的生成质量。 这些结果凸显了视觉轨迹重定向对于实现超越单纯文本到图像映射的稳健概念擦除的重要性。 项目页面为 https://qianlong0502.github.io/VisualErase-Homepage/ 。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models can synthesize diverse, high-quality images from natural-language descriptions ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Nichol et al., 2021 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Their capabilities emerge from training on web-scale image-text corpora, for which exhaustive content filtering remains difficult ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . Consequently, pretrained models can reproduce copyrighted artistic styles, recognizable identities, and explicit content ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023 ; Schramowski et al., 2023 ) . Concept erasure aims to address these risks by removing a designated concept from a pretrained model while preserving generation of non-target content. ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型能够根据自然语言描述生成多样化、高质量的图像（Rombach 等人，2022；Nichol 等人，2021；Saharia 等人，2022）。 它们的能力源于在大规模网络图像-文本语料库上的训练，而对这些语料库进行全面的内容过滤仍然十分困难（Schuhmann 等人，2022）。 因此，预训练模型能够重现受版权保护的艺术风格、可识别的身份以及露骨内容（Jiang 等人，2023；Carlini 等人，2023；Somepalli 等人，2023；Schramowski 等人，2023）。 概念擦除旨在通过从预训练模型中移除指定概念来解决这些风险，同时保留对非目标内容的生成能力。 （Gandikota 等人，2023；Kumari 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2024a）。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), many existing methods formulate concept erasure as redirecting generation under target-related text conditions toward alternative concepts. Early methods weaken the response to a target prompt or modify the cross-attention layers that bind text to visual features ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) . Later methods improve scale, efficiency, or robustness by editing additional textual associations and by training against adversarial prompts ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Srivatsan et al., 2025 ) . Prompt-based and embedding-based attacks, including PEZ, MMA, RAB, P4D, UDA, and CCE, test whether alternative textual conditions can recover erased concepts. ( Wen et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Tsai et al., 2024 ; Chin et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ; Pham et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: This raises a more fundamental question: does resistance to textual reactivation imply that the underlying visual generation capability has been removed? TINA+ probes this gap through text-free visual inversion, showing that target concepts can remain recoverable despite strong resistance to prompt-based attacks ( Xiang et al., 2026a ; Xiang et al., 2026b ) . Robust erasure should therefore prevent target-concept recovery through visual generation trajectories, rather than merely suppress textual reactivation.

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce VisualErase , a new concept-erasure paradigm based on visual trajectory redirection. As illustrated in Figure 1 (b), its central idea is to redirect concept-bearing denoising trajectories toward content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts that serve as explicit visual endpoints. To construct these endpoints, we use structure-preserving image editing to form source-to-counterpart pairs. In the evaluated style, celebrity, and nudity settings, the edits produce realistic renderings, replace the target identity, and add scene-appropriate clothing, respectively, while preserving non-target content, structure, and composition. We then analytically derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair, translating the specified visual outcome into direct supervision for trajectory redirection. Conditional supervision alone, however, does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. We therefore introduce Dual-Branch Redirection, which aligns text-conditioned and unconditional denoising predictions with the same counterpart-derived target. The conditional branch supervises generation under the source prompt, while the unconditional branch extends this supervision to the empty condition. Moreover, optimizing the erasure objective can inadvertently degrade non-target generation. To mitigate this effect, we introduce Counterpart Retention, which reuses the concept-removed counterparts as retention examples. Its loss matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model on these examples and is jointly optimized with the dual-branch redirection loss.

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure demonstrate that VisualErase suppresses both standard and adversarial concept recovery while preserving general generation quality. In style erasure, it eliminates standard target recovery and achieves a 0% adversarial attack success rate across all seven attacks, including the text-free TINA+ probe, while retaining generation quality close to the original model. VisualErase is also effective for celebrity and nudity erasure, where target recovery remains zero or near zero under diverse attacks. Recent robust erasure methods improve resistance by alternating adversarial token search with additional erasure updates ( Srivatsan et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, VisualErase requires neither adversarial prompt search nor attack-generated supervision. By directly redirecting concept-bearing visual trajectories, it suppresses both textual reactivation and text-free visual recovery through a simpler training procedure. These results demonstrate that directly erasing the target-related visual generation capability yields more complete erasure than redirecting text-to-image mappings.

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure aims to remove undesired concepts from pretrained diffusion models while preserving their ability to generate non-target content. Early methods fine-tune selected U-Net parameters or suppress concept-specific attention responses ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) . Subsequent work improves efficiency and scalability through closed-form model editing or lightweight adapters ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ) . General machine unlearning methods further select influential parameters or constrain their updates when removing concepts from diffusion models ( Fan et al., 2024 ; Wu and Harandi, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Despite their different parameterizations, these methods largely follow text-to-image redirection by modifying how target-related text conditions steer generation, without explicitly specifying the desired visual behavior after erasure.
paragraphs.zh: 概念擦除旨在从预训练的扩散模型中移除不需要的概念，同时保留其生成非目标内容的能力。 早期的方法通过微调选定的 U-Net 参数或抑制特定概念的注意力响应来实现（Gandikota 等人，2023；Kumari 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2024a）。 后续研究通过闭式模型编辑或轻量级适配器提升了效率和可扩展性（Gandikota 等人，2024；Lu 等人，2024；Lyu 等人，2024）。 通用的机器学习遗忘方法在从扩散模型中移除概念时，会进一步选择具有影响力的参数或约束其更新（Fan 等人，2024；Wu 和 Harandi，2024；Wu 等人，2025）。 尽管这些方法的参数化方式不同，但它们大多遵循文本到图像的重新定向策略，即通过修改与目标相关的文本条件对生成过程的引导方式来实现，而未明确指定擦除后期望的视觉行为。

paragraphs.en: The vulnerability of erased models to alternative prompts has motivated defenses that explicitly incorporate adversarial robustness. RECE strengthens erasure against concept restoration, AdvUnlearn introduces adversarial training, and STEREO alternates adversarial token search with additional erasure updates ( Gong et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Srivatsan et al., 2025 ) . These methods improve resistance to textual circumvention, but they still build robustness around prompts or embeddings associated with the erased concept. Our proposed VisualErase instead acts directly on visual denoising trajectories without adversarial prompt mining or attack-generated supervision.

paragraphs.en: Attacks on concept erasure have evolved from discrete prompt search to continuous embedding optimization and text-free visual probes. Prompt-space methods search for alternative expressions or optimized tokens that recover a suppressed concept ( Wen et al., 2023 ; Chin et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Tsai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ) . CCE instead learns a continuous token embedding that serves as a proxy for the erased concept ( Pham et al., 2024 ) . TINA+ recovers erased concepts through text-free visual inversion, revealing that concept-related visual generation can remain accessible after textual suppression ( Xiang et al., 2026b ; Xiang et al., 2026a ) . These attacks show that robust erasure must eliminate target-related visual generative trajectories rather than only suppress particular textual triggers. This is the central objective of our proposed VisualErase .

paragraphs.en: Overview. VisualErase aims to remove a target visual concept while preserving generation of non-target content. Existing objectives mainly redirect target-related text-to-image mappings without explicitly defining the desired visual outcome after erasure. To make this objective concrete, as shown in Figure 2 , we first pair each concept-bearing source image with a content-aligned counterpart in which the concept has been removed. Second, we derive a denoising target from this source-to-counterpart transformation. Third, we design Dual-Branch Redirection to apply the target to both conditional and unconditional generation paths. Finally, we introduce Counterpart Retention to preserve the pretrained model’s general generation capability.
paragraphs.zh: 概述。 VisualErase 旨在移除目标视觉概念，同时保留非目标内容的生成。 现有目标主要重新引导与目标相关的文本到图像映射，但未明确定义擦除后期望的视觉结果。 为使这一目标具体化，如图 2 所示，我们首先将每张包含概念的源图像与其内容对齐的对应图像配对，后者已移除了该概念。 其次，我们从这种从源图像到对应图像的转换中推导出一个去噪目标。 第三，我们设计了双分支重定向，以便将该目标应用于条件生成和无条件生成路径。 最后，我们引入对应图像保留机制，以保留预训练模型的一般生成能力。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 (a), for style erasure, we use Stable Diffusion v1.5 image-to-image editing ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) to generate a realistic full-image counterpart. We extract an HED SoftEdge map ( Xie and Tu, 2015 ) and a MiDaS depth map ( Ranftl et al., 2022 ) from the source image and use them as complementary ControlNet conditions ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) to preserve the scene layout and depicted content. For celebrity erasure, we use the GIPHY Celebrity Detector (GCD) 1 1 1 https://github.com/Giphy/celeb-detection-oss to identify the face associated with the target identity. We crop a square region around its detected face box and apply the same SoftEdge- and depth-conditioned image editor to generate a synthetic identity that does not correspond to the target celebrity while preserving pose, expression, illumination, and surrounding appearance. We then blend the edited face through a feathered mask. For nudity erasure, we derive garment-coverage masks from NudeNet 2 2 2 https://github.com/notAI-tech/NudeNet detections and use the Stable Diffusion v1.5 inpainting model 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-inpainting to add scene-appropriate opaque clothing. paragraphs.en: We report concept accuracy under standard target prompts (ACC) and attack success rate (ASR), with lower values indicating stronger erasure. Following UDA, Van Gogh recovery is measured by the Top-1 prediction of a 129-class ViT-Base style classifier pretrained on ImageNet and fine-tuned on WikiArt ( Zhang et al., 2024c ; Wu et al., 2020 ; Saleh and Elgammal, 2015 ) . Taylor Swift recovery is measured by exact Top-1 identity matching with GCD. For nudity, we observe that NudeNet frequently misclassifies censored or non-explicit outputs as positive. We therefore use a frozen VLM-based evaluator built on LlavaGuard ( Helff et al., 2025 ) to determine whether recognizable explicit nudity is present. Further details of this evaluation protocol and its comparison with NudeNet are provided in Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在标准目标提示下报告概念准确率（ACC）和攻击成功率（ASR），数值越低表示擦除效果越强。 遵循 UDA 方法，梵高风格的恢复通过一个在 ImageNet 上预训练并在 WikiArt 上微调的 129 类 ViT-Base 风格分类器的 Top-1 预测来衡量（Zhang et al., 2024c；Wu et al., 2020；Saleh and Elgammal, 2015）。 泰勒·斯威夫特风格的恢复通过 GCD 进行精确的 Top-1 身份匹配来衡量。 对于裸体内容，我们观察到 NudeNet 经常将经过审查或非露骨的内容错误分类为阳性。 因此，我们使用一个基于 LlavaGuard（Helff et al., 2025）构建的固定 VLM 评估器，来判断是否存在可识别的露骨裸体内容。 关于此评估协议及其与 NudeNet 的比较的更多细节，请参见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: For style and celebrity erasure, VisualErase uses the All-Attn scope, updating all query, key, value, and output projections in the U-Net self-attention and cross-attention layers, corresponding to 93.5M trainable parameters. We optimize the model with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) using a batch size of 4, a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , and a weight decay of 0.01 for 1,000 updates. We set λ c = λ u = 0.5 \lambda_{c}=\lambda_{u}=0.5 and λ r = 1.0 \lambda_{r}=1.0 . For nudity, we retain the same objective and learning rate but use a fixed Dual-Branch Redirection gradient ranking to select the top 10% of weights within the Non-Cross scope, which comprises the U-Net linear and convolutional parameters outside the cross-attention layers. The nudity model is trained for 5,000 updates. Its saliency construction and optimizer implementation are detailed in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the complete Van Gogh comparison. Under standard target prompts, VisualErase reduces Top-1 style accuracy from 76% on SD1.4 to 0%. All seven attacks recover the target style from SD1.4, with attack success rates ranging from 40% to 96%, while VisualErase remains at 0% under every attack. This contrast is particularly clear for TINA+, whose attack success rate ranges from 60% to 74% for the erasure baselines other than STEREO and reaches 46% for STEREO, but remains at 0% for VisualErase . VisualErase also achieves 0% under CCE. Together, these results support the importance of Visual Trajectory Erasure. Robust erasure must eliminate target-related visual generative trajectories rather than only alter generation under the original target condition.
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了完整的梵高风格对比结果。 在标准目标提示下，VisualErase将SD1.4上的Top-1风格准确率从76%降至0%。 所有七种攻击都能从SD1.4中恢复目标风格，攻击成功率在40%到96%之间，而VisualErase在所有攻击下的准确率仍为0%。 这种对比在TINA+上尤为明显：对于除STEREO外的擦除基线，其攻击成功率为60%至74%，对STEREO的成功率则达到46%，但对VisualErase仍为0%。 VisualErase在CCE下的准确率也为0%。 综合来看，这些结果支持了视觉轨迹擦除的重要性。 稳健的擦除必须消除与目标相关的视觉生成轨迹，而不仅仅是改变原始目标条件下的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: We presented VisualErase , which formulates robust concept erasure as visual trajectory erasure. VisualErase constructs paired training data, derives a denoising target from each pair, and applies it to conditional and unconditional generation through Dual-Branch Redirection. Counterpart Retention preserves general generation capability. Experiments across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure demonstrate zero or near-zero target recovery under seven attacks while maintaining strong generation quality. These results show that robust concept erasure requires erasing target-related visual generative trajectories rather than redirecting text-to-image mappings alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VisualErase，它将稳健的概念擦除转化为视觉轨迹的擦除。 VisualErase 构建成对的训练数据，从每对数据中推导出降噪目标，并通过双分支重定向将其应用于条件生成和无条件生成。 对应项保留机制可维持通用的生成能力。 在风格、名人及裸体内容擦除方面的实验表明，在七种攻击下，目标内容的恢复率为零或接近于零，同时仍能保持强大的生成质量。 这些结果表明，实现稳健的概念擦除需要擦除与目标相关的视觉生成轨迹，而不仅仅是重定向文本到图像的映射关系。

paragraphs.en: All counterparts are constructed offline using publicly available, locally hosted diffusion models. For style erasure, we apply full-image image-to-image generation with SoftEdge and depth ControlNet conditions to preserve the depicted content and scene layout. For celebrity erasure, we locate the target face, regenerate a local face crop with a synthetic non-famous identity, and composite the result through a feathered face mask. paragraphs.en: These observations do not imply that GPT-based models intrinsically lack image-editing capability. paragraphs.en: The main Nudity results measure whether an attack recovers recognizable explicit anatomy rather than whether it merely activates a low-level nudity detector. paragraphs.en: The discrepancy with classifier-only evaluation is substantial for the final VisualErase under UDA. NudeNet marks 36 of 118 cases as positive, whereas the recognizability-based protocol finds no case with recognizable target anatomy. The eight examples in Figure 6 illustrate the main causes. Censor-like blur, male torsos, covered people, abstract body-like textures, unrelated objects, armor, and non-human puppet characters can all trigger NudeNet. These cues produce many false positives. Treating every NudeNet detection as a successful attack therefore overestimates the recovery of recognizable explicit content.
paragraphs.zh: 在 UDA 条件下，最终 VisualErase 与仅使用分类器的评估结果存在显著差异。 NudeNet 将 118 个案例中的 36 个标记为阳性，而基于可识别性的协议则未发现任何具有可识别目标解剖结构的案例。 图 6 中的八个示例说明了主要原因。 类似审查制度的模糊处理、男性躯干、被遮挡的人物、抽象类人体纹理、无关物体、盔甲以及非人类傀儡角色都可能触发 NudeNet。 这些线索会导致大量误报。 因此，将每一次 NudeNet 检测都视为成功攻击，会高估可识别的露骨内容被恢复的比例。

sents.en: The eight examples in Figure 6 illustrate the main causes.

sents.en: Censor-like blur, male torsos, covered people, abstract body-like textures, unrelated objects, armor, and non-human puppet characters can all trigger NudeNet.
sents.zh: 类似审查制度的模糊处理、男性躯干、被遮挡的人物、抽象类人体纹理、无关物体、盔甲以及非人类傀儡角色都可能触发 NudeNet。

sents.en: These cues produce many false positives.
sents.zh: 这些线索会导致大量误报。

sents.en: Treating every NudeNet detection as a successful attack therefore overestimates the recovery of recognizable explicit content.
sents.zh: 因此，将每一次 NudeNet 检测都视为成功攻击，会高估可识别的露骨内容被恢复的比例。

paragraphs.en: Nudity exhibits greater variation in pose, anatomy, composition, and rendering than style or celebrity identity. paragraphs.zh: 裸体在姿势、解剖结构、构图和渲染方面的差异，比风格或名人身份更为显著。 仅更新注意力投影可能导致模型无法充分捕捉这种差异，而更新整个 Non-Cross 范围虽然能提升消除效果，但会牺牲生成质量。 我们保留自然的穿衣对应体以及相同的训练目标，然后将参数更新限制在 Non-Cross 范围内。

paragraphs.en: We estimate the scores with four deterministic passes over the 109 paired examples and freeze the resulting ranking. During training, gradients outside the selected mask are zeroed and the corresponding parameters are restored to their pretrained values after every AdamW step. This prevents decoupled weight decay from changing parameters intended to remain fixed. The mask changes only which parameters are updated. Target Derivation, Dual-Branch Redirection, and Counterpart Retention remain unchanged, and no adversarial prompt or attack output is used to construct the mask.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 109 个成对示例进行四次确定性遍历以估算分数，并冻结由此产生的排名。 在训练期间，选定掩码之外的梯度会被置零，并且在每个 AdamW 步骤之后，相应的参数会恢复为其预训练值。 这可以防止解耦权重衰减改变那些本应保持固定的参数。 该掩码仅改变哪些参数会被更新。 目标推导、双分支重定向和对应项保留保持不变，并且不会使用对抗性提示或攻击输出来构建掩码。

paragraphs.en: All rows use the complete ACC and TINA+ evaluations together with COCO-30K. The selected 10% mask reaches 0% ACC and 0% TINA+ recovery while retaining an FID of 15.5 and a CLIP score of 26.6. paragraphs.en: We compare the wall-clock time required by STEREO and VisualErase to erase the Van Gogh style on a single NVIDIA H100. Timing begins when each training program loads SD1.4 and ends after the final erased checkpoint is written. Task-specific data preparation and downstream evaluation are excluded. The STEREO run includes two STE rounds. Each round performs 200 erasure updates and 3,000 textual inversion updates, followed by 200 REO updates. VisualErase uses a single training run of 1,000 updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了 STEREO 和 VisualErase 在单块 NVIDIA H100 上消除梵高风格所需的实际运行时间。 计时从每个训练程序加载 SD1.4 时开始，并在最后一个经过擦除的检查点写入后结束。 任务特定的数据准备和下游评估不包含在内。 STEREO 的运行包括两轮 STE。 每轮执行 200 次擦除更新和 3,000 次文本反转更新，随后进行 200 次 REO 更新。 VisualErase 使用单次包含 1,000 次更新的训练运行。

paragraphs.en: VisualErase reduces the measured training time by 52.8%. The difference arises because STEREO alternates erasure with repeated adversarial token optimization, whereas VisualErase performs one paired visual trajectory training run. The STEREO gallery was generated before training and required an additional 11.8 minutes. This offline preparation time is reported separately because paired data construction for VisualErase is likewise performed before training.
paragraphs.zh: VisualErase将测得的训练时间减少了52.8%。 这种差异源于STEREO在擦除操作与重复的对抗性标记优化之间交替进行，而VisualErase则执行一次成对的视觉轨迹训练运行。 STEREO图库在训练前生成，并额外需要11.8分钟。 这段离线准备时间被单独报告，因为VisualErase的成对数据构建同样是在训练前完成的。

paragraphs.en: We additionally examine Tench as an object-erasure setting. As shown in Figure 7 , VisualErase suppresses recognizable Tench under both standard target prompts and TINA+ attacks. However, the ImageNet classifier used for this setting frequently maps fishing scenes, blurred objects, or generic fish to the Tench class, as illustrated in Figure 8 . We therefore present this setting as a qualitative analysis rather than a detailed quantitative comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还进一步将 Tench 作为一个对象擦除场景进行了研究。 如图 7 所示，VisualErase 在标准目标提示和 TINA+ 攻击两种情况下都能抑制可识别的 Tench。 然而，该场景所使用的 ImageNet 分类器经常将捕鱼场景、模糊物体或普通鱼类映射到 Tench 类别，如图 8 所示。 因此，我们将此场景作为定性分析来呈现，而非详细的定量比较。
